heading: A century of service. One community.
description: Lions Club FSBM is a community of dedicated volunteers serving the greater Casablanca area since 2015.
missionDescription: To empower volunteers to serve their communities, meet humanitarian needs, encourage peace, and promote international understanding.
visionDescription: To be the leading service organization in Casablanca, creating lasting positive change through community-driven initiatives.
valuesDescription: Integrity, compassion, service, diversity, and leadership guide everything we do as we work to make our community better.
storyP1: Founded in 2015, Lions Club FSBM is a student service club at the Faculté des Sciences Ben M'Sik, Université Hassan II de Casablanca — and part of Lions Clubs International, the world's largest service club organization. What started as a handful of students has grown into an active community of young volunteers serving Casablanca.
storyP2: Our action is on the ground: blood-donation caravans organized with Club Santé & Sport — 209 donations collected in October 2025 alone — visits and activities at the Aïn Chock home for the elderly, creative workshops with pupils of the Al Massira Al Khadra primary school, and Ramadan food distribution for families in need.
storyP3: The real measure of our work is simple: a blood bag that saves a life, a smile from an elder who felt remembered, a child who learned something new. That is what keeps us going — and what we will keep doing, for as long as Casablanca needs us.
